decision_needed.question: The Depreciation Fund (300,000.00) and Employee Benefit Fund (19,215.13) each print a receipt labelled 'Allocation from General Fund', but the General Fund schedules (B, M and A-1) show no matching disbursement or transfer out, and the General Fund balance rolls forward without it. Are these real transfers (and the General Fund outflow is missing) or receipts from another source?
decision_needed.recorded_as: Kept as receipts (category other, review) in the receipts list, matching the printed Total Receipts of 6,733,808.11; in detail recorded as other financing. Not included in transfers_in/out.

notes: Cash (modified cash basis) school district. Governmental funds statement = Exhibit III (trimmed p8-13) Total Governmental Funds column; all funds including School Nutrition and Activities are presented as governmental funds, so business_type is null. Beginning/ending cash = beginning/end of year fund balance from Exhibit III p13 (6,757,500.70 and 7,057,441.31); roll-forward: 6,757,500.70 + 6,733,808.11 - 6,433,867.50 + 135,000 - 135,000 = 7,057,441.31. Transfers 135,000 = General Fund to Activities 65,000 and School Nutrition 70,000; the receiving funds' Schedules F and G match General Fund Schedule M p32 (cross-check OK). The Depreciation (300,000) and Employee Benefit (19,215.13) 'Allocation from General Fund' receipts have no matching General Fund outflow (see decision_needed). Local, County, State and Federal Receipts lines were split into component lines using the General and fund schedules (pp15, 21-25), combined across funds with computed notes; each group adds to the printed total column line. State Receipts split out Homestead Exemption, Property Tax Credit, Nameplate Capacity Tax and Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate as their own categories; County Receipts split into Fines and Licenses (2110) and ESU Receipts (2210). Non-Revenue Receipts 308,953.81 split into 300,000.00 (Depreciation, p19), 8,315.55 (Special Building insurance adjustments, p23), 638.26 (General Other, p16). Balance sheet (verifier fix, attempt 3, user rule 2026-10-27): the Exhibit III governmental funds statement of assets and fund balances (Total Governmental Funds column, p13: Cash and Deposits 6,521,444.61 + County Treasurers' Balance 535,996.70 = 7,057,441.31) equals the Exhibit I government-wide figures, so the balance sheet now comes from Exhibit III with fund balance by classification (Assigned 3,919,025.58, Unassigned 3,138,415.73) instead of Exhibit I's single Unrestricted 7,057,441.31; no liabilities. Statement of activities (Exhibit II, pp2-7) not used for lines. Detail: General Fund receipts from Schedule A (p15-16); General Fund disbursements by program and object from Schedule M (pp26-32), which supersedes Schedule B (pp17-18, program totals, not recorded to avoid double counting); lines with blank actual (budget only) omitted, e.g. 3990 Other State Receipts, 5400 Loan Proceeds, 2210, 2211 and several object lines. Program lines follow the report's own grouping (re-check attempt 2): 3540 State Early Childhood 1,250.00 + 3551 Career Education 6,932.82 = the statement's State Categorical Programs line 8,182.82 (p11), so their detail category is State Categorical Programs; 6406, 6408, 6969 and 6992 REAP lines (2,981.00 + 54,268.00 + 30,746.04 + 861.05 + 30,367.71 + 4,538.80 = 123,762.60) = the statement's Federal Programs line (p11), so their category is Federal Programs. Other fund schedules C, D, F, G, I, J, L recorded in detail. Transfer/allocation lines in detail are section other financing and included in the printed schedule totals (includes). Schedule A-1 (summary, p14) and Schedule N (county treasurers' general fund, pp33-34, pass-through collections) not recorded in detail; Schedule N total receipts agree with General Fund property tax and related lines. 'Property' object lines categorized as equipment purchases; 'Other Property Services' as professional/contract services; 'Other Items' as miscellaneous with review (object not itemized). Special Building budget column alignment: 50,000 shown beside 3180 row (could belong to nameplate 3133). Verifier fix (attempt 3): Special Building '1910 Rental' 18,290.63 receipt is category Rentals; School Nutrition '1620 Non-Reimbursable' 4,087.90 (non-reimbursable meal sales, p22) is School Lunch Sales in both receipts and detail. v7 re-trim added trimmed p35 (report p62, original p68): Schedule P, Exeter-Milligan School Facilities Joint Public Agency (unaudited), beginning 19,873.16, property taxes 0.00, capital improvements 19,873.16, ending 0.00. The JPA is a separate entity not included in Exhibit III's governmental fund totals, so it is not added to receipts, disbursements or detail. Read pages 1-35 of 35
